about: Sibling-matrix cells (defect class x SDK family) where the family has no counterpart API for the class, so no run can judge them. scripts/py/sibling_matrix.py reads this file: a ruled cell shows as not applicable with its reason, unless the runs or a public record give the cell a result, which always wins. A class or family that does not exist in the matrix is an error. Each reason names what the family lacks, read from the SDK source at the versions the kit pins.
